command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '===SUBJECT==='
sha256sum buehne.html buehne_daemon.py filmlook.js
echo '===SERVICE==='
systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service || true
echo '===GIT==='
git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -80 || true
echo '===HTML_KEY_LINES==='
grep -nE 'parallax|blink|eye|gaze|roll|shoulder|body|pose|ausdruck_erweitert|relief2|canvas|filmlook' buehne.html | head -220 || true
echo '===ASSET_COUNTS==='
for d in kopf_* head_* augen* eyes* ausdruck_erweitert ausdruck_erweitert_ai ausdruck_erweitert_relief2 body* koerper* schultern* shoulder* depth* *relief*; do if test -e "$d"; then printf '%s ' "$d"; find "$d" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l; fi; done | head -100
echo '===TOP_LEVEL==='
find . -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -printf '%f\n' | sort | head -160
echo '===RESOURCE==='
ps -eo pid,pcpu,pmem,comm,args --sort=-pcpu | head -18
echo SCOPE=READ_ONLY_GO_REENTRY_INSPECTION
